research_boundary: Engineering implementation, technical verification, UI/API availability and DATA collection are not equivalent to scientific EVID. Scientific maturity is tracked independently through registered questions, frozen protocols, source-bound DATA, human-reviewed EVID, independent replication and attribution. No stage score establishes AGI, consciousness, sentience or biological equivalence.
note: Alpha.7 is a repository-hardening and public-readiness pre-release. It changes branch/release governance, active workflow hygiene, publication discoverability and visitor-facing repository structure; it does not create new scientific EVID or independent replication.

development_state.summary: Alpha.7 is prepared from an exact green develop integration state. The release tag is created only after the release PR merges to main and post-merge CI succeeds.
